name: Hongmian Zhihui Science and Technology Innovation Co.,Ltd.Guangzhou
summary: Hongmian Zhihui Science and Technology Innovation Co.,Ltd.Guangzhou engages in the production and sale of edible sugar, beverages, and other food products in China and internationally. It offers various refined sugars, such as brown and white sugars under the Hongmian brand; soda, pineapple beer beverages, craft beer, wine series, liquor, and Double Happiness craft beer. The company also provides hand sanitizers, bleaching liquids, chlorine bleach, toilet cleaners, fruit and vegetable tableware cleaners, and clothing disinfectants; and laundry serum, beads, and detergents.
